Plainpalais Jonction — Geneva, Switzerland

In detail

The university quarter, the plaine de Plainpalais with its flea market, and the Jonction where the Rhône and the Arve meet. Lively, student-heavy and one of the better places to be in Geneva. The plaine is a large open space that empties at night, which is the whole of the night rating; nothing area-specific beyond that was found.
